newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Lehman starts five biotech/drug cos.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Lehman starts five biotech/drug cos.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers said analyst Matthew Murray initiated coverage of two biotechnology/drug companies with outperform ratings and initiated three others with venture ratings.
-- Arris Pharmaceutical Corp and BioCryst Pharmaceuticals Inc were rated outperform.
-- Houghten Pharmaceuticals Inc, Transkaryotic Therapies Inc and Tripos Inc were rated venture.
-- said Arris's proprietary "Delta" technology offers an important advantage in the discovery of lead compounds against protease targets.
-- said Arris has seven corporate collaborations valued at up to $248 million, allowing the company to maintain a low cash burn rate.
-- said expects large upside potential for BioCryst's lead drug candidate BCX-34 if it is able to safely and effectively inhibit T-cells.
-- said BioCryst is in excellent financial position from its recent public offering.
-- said believes Houghten's new small molecule combinatorial chemistry technology will drive company's valuation.
-- said Houghten has modest corporate collaborations and modest cash position.
-- said Transkaryotic stock is high risk with potentially high return.
-- sees Transkaryotic battle with Amgen Inc over Epogen patents. Amgen has patent on gene for erythropoietin, but not on the natural erythropoietin protein.
-- said Transkaryotic is in strong financial position.
-- said Tripos's combinatorial chemistry technology alliance makes use of company's software expertise.
-- said Tripos is profitable but undercapitalized.
